signals.signal: RoPay scheme participant register now lists 11 institutions: CEC Bank, Libra, BRD, ING, BCR, Banca Transilvania, Salt Bank, Raiffeisen (Alias only), VISTA Bank (incl. NFC), UniCredit, plus BRCI 'coming soon'. Service depth varies by bank (full / partial / alias-only).
signals.source_name: RoPay - Participating institutions (ropay.ro, official scheme site)
signals.implies: A national QR/NFC account-to-account rail is being built alongside cards. Printec POS/acquiring and merchant-onboarding work must support RoPay QR/SoftPOS acceptance next to card acceptance; uneven bank readiness (Raiffeisen alias-only, UniCredit/BRD partial) is a concrete integration gap to sell into.
signals.likelihood: Very likely - scheme is live and adding participants monthly
signals.followup: Track which banks upgrade from partial/alias to full RoPay, and whether ATM/self-service RoPay cash-in/cash-out is added

signals.signal: BRD extended RoPay in the YOU BRD mobile app on 06/08/2026: instant merchant payments in physical stores, online checkout, static QR in stores, QR scanned from POS terminals and from utility invoices - all card-free and zero-commission, over TRANSFOND Instant Payments.
signals.implies: BRD is pushing acceptance to POS terminals via QR. Creates demand for POS estate software able to display dynamic RoPay QR alongside card acceptance - directly Printec POS/acquiring and managed-services territory.
signals.followup: Find BRD's own press release on brd.ro and whether its POS estate needs a terminal-software upgrade for dynamic QR

signals.signal: EuPlatesc began the first stage of a DIRECT connection to TRANSFOND's RoPay infrastructure on 24/08/2026, letting merchants take RoPay without a bank acting as technical intermediary.
signals.implies: Acquiring intermediation is being disintermediated: PSPs can connect straight to the national rail. Printec should target PSPs/processors, not only banks, for RoPay-enabled POS and merchant onboarding/eKYC.
signals.followup: Confirm whether other Romanian processors follow with direct TRANSFOND connections

signals.signal: From 12/08/2026 ENGIE Romania customers can pay bills via RoPay both online and IN CUSTOMER SERVICE CENTRES using SoftPOS technology (ING integration). Separately, ING Business Banking clients can activate RoPay in one click with 0% pricing on individual payments through July 2027 (10/08/2026), and eMAG launched RoPay-with-ING checkout on 15/07/2026.
signals.source_name: RoPay press releases (ropay.ro, official scheme site)
signals.implies: SoftPOS (phone-as-terminal) is being used for face-to-face bill payment - a direct substitute for both cash desks and classic POS hardware. Printec must position SoftPOS/merchant onboarding, and note the cash-displacement effect on ATM/branch cash volumes.
signals.followup: Identify the SoftPOS vendor behind the ING/ENGIE deployment

The new SOC engineer plus data-engineering pair points at security operations and analytics build-out (Printec transaction monitoring / fraud / HSM adjacency).
signals.likelihood: High - two consecutive months of decline with senior roles closing
signals.followup: Confirm who was appointed to the Cards Domain architecture role and whether a cards/issuing platform tender follows

signals.signal: BCR's live vacancy list on the Erste group ATS fell to 18 on 31/08/2026 (29 on 31/07/2026; 36 on 24/06/2026) - a 50% decline in ten weeks. All 18 roles are commercial or risk (Partener Clienti Retail, Corporate/Senior Corporate Relationship Manager x6, Director Zonal Retail, Risk Manager, Portfolio Manager, Specialist Trezorerie, Loan Capital Market Expert). ZERO technology, ZERO payments/cards, ZERO ATM/cash/self-service roles for a third consecutive month.
signals.implies: BCR is not building channel or payments capability in-house in Romania - technology is centralised at Erste group level in Vienna/Erste Digital. Printec's route into BCR runs through Erste group procurement, not the Romanian entity; local selling effort is likely wasted.
signals.likelihood: Sustained pattern across three monthly observations
signals.followup: Check Erste Digital / Erste Group Vienna postings for the Romanian channel and ATM workstreams instead

signals.signal: From 01/01/2026 the 50,000 lei annual cash-turnover threshold that used to exempt small merchants was ABOLISHED: essentially every trader and self-employed person (PFA) registered at the Trade Register who collects money at a point of sale must accept card or another electronic payment method (SoftPOS, payment link and QR explicitly count). Fines are 20,000-50,000 lei for having no electronic acceptance at all, and 5,000-7,500 lei for refusing a card when a terminal exists.
signals.source_name: avocatnet.ro legal analysis of Law 239/2025 / OUG 193/2002; corroborated by Global Payments Romania and PayPoint merchant guidance
signals.implies: A legally forced, near-universal expansion of the Romanian acceptance estate - the single largest POS/SoftPOS/merchant-onboarding opportunity in Printec's footprint this year. The law's explicit recognition of QR is also what makes RoPay acceptance commercially viable at the till.
signals.likelihood: In force since 01/01/2026 and already visible in the BNR terminal numbers
signals.followup: Obtain the Monitorul Oficial text of Law 239/2025 for the exact article and any 2026 transition deadlines; check ANAF enforcement/sanction statistics

signals.entity: National Bank of Romania (BNR) - H2-2025 payment statistics
signals.signal: At 31/12/2025 Romania had 11,136 ATMs, UP 1,108 in six months; 729,408 POS terminals, UP 161,396 (+28%) in six months; 685,731 EFTPOS acceptance points (+120,300); and 28.63m active cards (+10.07% vs June 2025), of which 24.68m have a cash-withdrawal function.
signals.source_name: Business24 analysis of BNR payment statistics
signals.implies: Romania's ATM estate is GROWING (+11% in one half-year) while most of CEE/SEE shrinks - Romania is Printec's strongest ATM/recycler hardware market by direction of travel, and the POS explosion is a straight acquiring/terminal-estate and managed-services opportunity.
signals.likelihood: Confirmed historical data; trend likely continued into 2026
signals.followup: Get the H1-2026 BNR release direct from bnr.ro (interactive statistics database) when published, to confirm the ATM growth continued

signals.signal: H1-2026 results published 24/08/2026: net profit 2.1bn lei at bank level (+20.7% y/y), 2.5bn lei at group level (+26.8%), over 250,000 new clients in the half. Network reported at ~1,800 ATMs of which ~550 are MULTIFUNCTIONAL self-banking machines (cash deposit and withdrawal in lei and foreign currency, contactless, cardless withdrawal by BT Pay code). BT Pay has reached 4.6 million users.
signals.source_name: BankingNews.ro / iDevice.ro reports on Banca Transilvania H1-2026 results (24/08/2026); BT network description
signals.implies: Only about 31% of BT's ATM fleet is recycling/multifunctional - roughly 1,250 single-function machines are candidates for recycler replacement at Romania's largest bank. Strong profitability plus 250k new clients funds the capex. Core Printec cash-automation/recycler target.
signals.likelihood: High - BT has been converting to multifunctional machines steadily
signals.followup: Obtain BT's own H1-2026 results PDF (currently 403-blocked) for the exact ATM/multifunctional counts and any stated ATM capex; identify BT's incumbent ATM hardware vendor

signals.signal: Raiffeisen has MOVED its recruitment channel: raiffeisen.jobful.ro no longer resolves at all (DNS NXDOMAIN on 31/08/2026) and raiffeisen.ro/despre-noi/cariere now links only to eJobs.ro company 4779 and LinkedIn. The eJobs board shows 18 enumerable live roles on 31/08/2026 (totalCount 32), against ~54 on the Jobful portal on 31/07/2026. Seventeen of the 18 are branch/relationship roles; the single technology-relevant role is 'Product Manager Cards Issuing and Merchant Acceptance' (Bucuresti, posted 31/08/2026, closes 23/09/2026).
signals.source_name: raiffeisen.ro careers page and eJobs.ro public API (api.ejobs.ro/jobs?filters.companies=4779)
signals.implies: The baseline's 'Product Manager Squad Cards Issuing' has been RESCOPED to cover issuing AND MERCHANT ACCEPTANCE in one product ownership - Raiffeisen RO is unifying cards issuing with acquiring. That is the decision-making seat for POS estate, acceptance and RoPay-at-POS, and it is being filled right now. Raiffeisen is also the only major RoPay participant still limited to Alias payments, so acceptance build-out is its stated gap.
signals.likelihood: Very likely - role posted the day of observation
signals.followup: Watch for the Raiffeisen RO acquiring/POS programme once this product manager is in post; the jobful.ro portal loss should be removed from the Tier-0 cache

The stale single entry also suggests the register is under-maintained - cross-check SEAP/e-licitatie.ro for CEC notices.

signals.signal: BNR authorised NETOPIA as a PAYMENT INSTITUTION, entered in the BNR register as IP-RO-0018 and active from 10/07/2026, for the payment service 'acceptance of payment instruments' (i.e. acquiring) in its own name. NETOPIA serves 25,000+ merchants and processes over 30% of Romania's online card payments. The licence explicitly opens its path to join RoPay directly and to offer merchant financing.
signals.source_name: Economedia / Ziarul Financiar / BankingNews, citing the BNR register of payment institutions
signals.implies: Romania's largest online acquirer no longer needs a sponsoring bank. Combined with EuPlatesc's direct TRANSFOND link, acquiring is shifting from banks to licensed PSPs - Printec's POS, merchant-onboarding/eKYC and transaction-monitoring buyers in Romania are increasingly non-bank payment institutions.
signals.followup: Verify entry IP-RO-0018 directly in the BNR register once bnr.ro is reachable via a browser; watch for NETOPIA joining RoPay as a direct participant

signals.signal: CEC Bank runs over 1,000 units nationally, HALF of them in rural areas, and is building 'agentii digitale' (digital agencies) in small towns and rural localities that combine in-person guidance with self-service technology access. 64% of its retail credits in 2025 were taken through digital channels, on ~4bn lei disbursed to retail. Context given in the same piece: Romania has POS terminals at under 50% of the EU average per 1,000 inhabitants, and 71% of over-15s hold a bank account against an EU average of 94% (rural 67%, urban 81%).
signals.source_name: Business24 - Romanian banks accelerate retail transformation
signals.implies: The 'agentie digitala' format is exactly a Printec self-service + digital-onboarding sale: assisted self-service kiosks, cash recyclers and eKYC in ~500 rural locations where a full cash desk is uneconomic. The financial-inclusion and POS-density gaps quantify the headroom.
signals.followup: Get CEC Bank's own description and rollout count for 'Agentia Digitala' (it appears in cec.ro navigation) and any associated procurement on cec.ro/achizitii

signals.signal: [STANDING - dated 2018, corrected] ING Bank Romania closed ALL physical cash desks from 29/10/2018 and converted branches into 'Self-Bank' self-service units, with new deposit-capable ATMs (cash in lei and euro, also usable by non-ING-card holders) replacing tellers and ING HomeBank as the main channel. NOTE: this item currently surfaces in search results mis-dated to 2026 - it was verified against the original Ziarul Financiar article and is 2018.
signals.source_name: Ziarul Financiar (original 2018 report), verified for date
signals.implies: ING is the proven Romanian precedent for a fully teller-less branch estate running on recyclers - the reference case to use when pitching cash automation to CEC, BT or BCR. Separately, ING is now the most active RoPay bank (ENGIE SoftPOS bill payment, eMAG checkout, Business Banking one-click), so it pairs an all-self-service branch with the most aggressive A2A acceptance push.
signals.followup: Establish who supplies and services ING Romania's Self-Bank deposit ATMs

signals.entity: BCR (Erste) / Banca Transilvania - self-service cash estate
signals.signal: BCR's 'Easy 24 Banking' zones run ATMs and multifunctional machines permanently available for cash deposit and withdrawal including in euro, currency exchange, bill payment, transfers, balance, PIN change and mini-statement. Banca Transilvania reports over 100,000 cash DEPOSITS per month through its BT Express Plus multifunctional machines. CEC Bank's fleet is 1,200+ ATM and MFM terminals, under a multi-year modernisation programme first funded at EUR 2.6m [STANDING - programme announced 2020].
signals.source_name: Bancherul.ro / Stiri de Cluj / Revista Biz (CEC modernisation, originally 21/07/2020)
signals.implies: All three of the largest Romanian networks are committed to deposit-capable self-service, and CEC's modernisation is explicitly MULTI-YEAR and still running - the recycler refresh cycle in Romania is live rather than saturated. Sizes the replaceable base: BT ~1,250 non-multifunctional machines, CEC 1,200+ terminals mid-programme.
signals.followup: Pin down current-year CEC modernisation tranche and its incumbent hardware vendor; these counts are aggregator-sourced and need a primary confirmation

signals.signal: LEADERSHIP: Robert Anghel, previously Chief Business Officer, was approved by BNR as CEO of Salt Bank, succeeding Gabriela Nistor who completed a ~two-year mandate and moved to the Board of Administration (announced 04/03/2026). Salt Bank, launched 04/04/2024 on the former Idea Bank licence, has passed 700,000 customers and is in Romania's top 10 by customer count. Salt is a full RoPay participant.
signals.implies: A digital-only bank inside the BT group scaling past 700k customers with a commercially-focused new CEO - a buyer for digital onboarding/eKYC, fraud and transaction monitoring rather than hardware, and a channel through which BT group tests technology before the main bank adopts it.
signals.followup: Track Salt Bank's eKYC/AML vendor choices as a leading indicator for the wider BT group
